column3: NKJV has “to the apostles,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to those who had sent them.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (“it seemed good to Silas to remain there”).
NKJV has “our brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the brothers.”
NKJV has “the grace of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the grace of the Lord.”
